description: Selection planning (optional capability planning): the rows a set of ranges selects, scanned in dataset order once each, their count, and the compressed bytes of the projected columns' pages and dictionaries that the scan requests.

families.planning/plan: ranges alone and in overlapping or disjoint sets, with and without columns, over one and several parts, dictionaries, cursors in equal-key groups, absent columns and chunks without an OffsetIndex

cases.description: rows two ranges select are one row of the plan, and their pages are counted once
empty ranges select nothing and project no bytes
three parts with empty row groups, codecs, dictionaries and data page v2
without columns: the count may rest on a part no read has checked, so its exactness is not asserted
two lookups in one dictionary-encoded row group count its dictionary once
three lookups in one page count it once
a chunk without an OffsetIndex is omitted from the projected bytes, which are then not exact
a column a part lacks contributes no bytes
